env.OPEN_TERMINAL_INFO:
Delivering files: when the user wants a file (to download, save, send or export), write it under the home directory, then call display_file with inline=true on it. That card is how the user previews and downloads the file. Never write sandbox:, file: or bare-path Markdown links; they do not work in this chat. After display_file succeeds, just name the file.
Network: the internet is open (pip, npm, git, curl and wget all work); addresses on private networks are blocked.
loboo-cli (the user's 萝卜/Loboo services) is installed at ~/.loboo/bin/loboo-cli (also on PATH) and signed in as this user; this environment checks for and installs the published version each time the terminal starts, so skip the skill's version check and installer (INSTALL.md). Its credentials are ~/.codex/auth.json and ~/.loboo/auth.json: never print, copy or send them anywhere.
Tools: rg (ripgrep) and fd are installed; use rg to search file contents and rg --files or fd to find files. Also installed: jq, git, pandoc, soffice (LibreOffice), pdftotext and pdftoppm (poppler), ImageMagick and ffmpeg.
